meta.title: {brand} — Every Vietnamese airline, one search
meta.description: {brand} connects directly to every airline in Vietnam. Compare live fares from Vietnam Airlines, Vietjet, Bamboo, Vietravel, Pacific and Sun PhuQuoc Airways — domestic and international — and book in seconds.

hero.label: Every airline in Vietnam · One search
hero.title: Fly Vietnam, booked in seconds.
hero.body: {brand} plugs straight into the booking systems of every Vietnamese airline. Real seats, real fares, confirmed by the carrier — no middlemen, no markups, no waiting.

search.label: Live inventory
search.title: The whole sky, in one search.
search.body: One query fans out to every carrier at once. {brand} reads availability live from each airline, so the fare you see is the fare you pay — down to the last seat.

airlines.label: Direct airline APIs
airlines.title: Wired straight into the airlines.
airlines.body: No screen-scraping and no resold inventory. {brand} holds direct API connections with each carrier, so your ticket is issued by the airline itself the moment you pay.

routes.label: Domestic flights
routes.title: From Hà Nội to Phú Quốc.
routes.body: {count} airports, from Điện Biên to Côn Đảo. Tap a route to search it live.

international.label: International flights
international.title: Where to next?
international.body: Straight from Hà Nội, TP. Hồ Chí Minh and Đà Nẵng to Asia, Europe and Australia. Tap a route to search it live.

ticket.label: Instant e-ticket
ticket.title: A boarding pass before you blink.
ticket.body: Pay with VietQR, MoMo, ZaloPay or any card. Your e-ticket lands in under a minute, with gate changes and delays pushed to your phone as they happen.

footer.tagline: Direct bookings with every airline in Vietnam.
footer.addressText: 5th floor, SABAY Building, 481 Cộng Hòa, Tân Bình Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
body: This is a demo website. I built it to show what I can do as an end-to-end developer, from 3D interaction and design to booking, payment and ticketing flows, and how I could contribute to Thanh Hoang.
It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Thanh Hoang. I claim no copyright over the company's name, logo or content. No real bookings or payments are made, and flight data is simulated.
If you represent Thanh Hoang and would like anything changed or removed, please get in touch and I will act on it promptly.
